title: OutlookAttachmentReference
description: Metadata and inline bytes for one attachment. When the bytes are available they are base64-encoded in contentBytes; otherwise unavailableReason explains why.

contentType.description: Media type of the bytes. Embedded messages are reported as message/rfc822.

size.description: Exact length of the attachment bytes.

isInline.description: True when the attachment is referenced from the message body by contentId.

contentId.description: Content-ID for an inline attachment, without angle brackets.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the attachment bytes, useful for de-duplicating attachments repeated across thread messages.

contentBytes.description: Base64-encoded attachment bytes, present when the bytes are available.

unavailableReason.description: Stable code explaining why bytes are not available, present instead of contentBytes. Known values include unsupported_attachment.
